oneOf.description: The client session's token is missing, invalid, foreign or expired.

reason.description: Present when the scope is held and the call is refused all the same: ceiling (it would grant a ceiling above the caller's own: a pairing, or raising another client session), local (only a local client session may ask it: an artefact path on the environment's machine, the desktop's stage) or program (a program client session may not ask it: the known-environments report, whose text reaches every run).

ceiling.description: With reason ceiling: the caller's own ceiling, the highest it may grant.

oneOf.description: The client session lacks the scope the method requires, named in data.scope; or, with data.reason ceiling, the call would grant a ceiling above the caller's own, named in data.ceiling; or, with data.reason local, only a local client session may ask it; or, with data.reason program, a program client session may not.

readiness.description: Why the environment cannot answer: it is not ready yet, or it is draining.

oneOf.description: The environment is starting or draining; data.readiness says which.

items.description: One schema issue: a code, the path to the offending value and a message.

oneOf.description: The params or the frame did not match the schema; data.issues lists the schema's issues.
The method's target does not exist.
The target's state does not allow the method now.
The environment failed; nothing the client sent is at fault.

tool.description: A managed tool, by the name it is found under on the PATH: claude (claude in your terminal, never the bundled binary), bao (OpenBao), vault (Vault), doppler, op (1Password), bws (Bitwarden Secrets Manager) or gh (GitHub).

action.description: What tools.run does: install (a tool not installed) or update (one installed by a method the harness drives); a Copy-only row runs nothing.

anyOf.description: A command line, each argument quoted as one word, steps joined by &&: as the user's login shell runs it, or as a person copies it.

command.description: The vendor's documented command, to copy and run where the harness cannot: the vendor script's update for a tool it installed by hand, else the install the table has for this platform. Null when there is none: vault, which the harness never installs or updates.

oneOf.description: The harness does not run this tool's install or update here: a Copy-only row (installed by hand, or by mise, asdf or Scoop, or not known how), a tool no method available on the environment installs, or vault, which is never installed; data.command is the vendor's documented command to copy.
